newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey Q1 trade deficit $4.133 billion, up 4.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Turkey Q1 trade deficit $4.133 billion, up 4.7 pct.

text.p: Turkey's trade deficit rose 4.7 percent in the first quarter of 1997 to $4.133 billion from $3.946 billion a year earlier, the State Statistics Institute (DIE) said.

Exports during the three months to March climbed 6.0 percent to $5.830 billion from $5.502 billion and imports rose 5.5 percent to $9.964 billion from $9.448 billion the previous year, the DIE said in a statement.
The March trade deficit declined 6.3 percent from a year earlier to $1.536 billion from $1.639 billion a year earlier.
Last week, the DIE announced a 44.7 percent rise in the trade deficit in the first ten months of 1996 to $15.394 billion from 10.636 billion the previous year.

The release of Turkish trade data for 1996 has been delayed because of technical difficulties arising from the country's customs union with the European Union which went into effect at the start of 1996.
